steps.title: Create app metadata configuration
steps.description: Establish the application name and correct package structure for DevToolbox.

steps.title: Configure the API schema
steps.description: Define the offline nature of DevToolbox with no backend dependency requirements.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up the app's permissions, hardware acceleration, target screens, and the Material NoActionBar theme.

steps.title: Configure Build Configuration
steps.description: Prepare compile SDK, target SDK, and basic Java 8 build options.

steps.title: Design Application Layout
steps.description: Create the main screen UI containing the horizontal navigation tabs and the three functional modules (Base64, JSON, Hasher).

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity
steps.description: Prepare activity initialization, define references to UI components, and setup background color assets.

steps.title: Implement Custom Tab Switching
steps.description: Implement the interactive tab switching logic with dynamic background changes to mirror Tailwind-style focus cues.

steps.title: Implement Text-to-Base64 logic
steps.description: Code the base64 conversion mechanism with native encoding/decoding and error catch states.

steps.title: Implement JSON syntax analyzer & formatter
steps.description: Integrate the real-time JSON formatter with validation indicators and standard indent printing.

steps.title: Implement multi-algorithm dynamic hashing
steps.description: Code the real-time hash generation (MD5 and SHA-256) running concurrently on-the-fly with standard Java MessageDigest.

steps.title: Build Clipboard Management Helper
steps.description: Create clipboard integration for quick copying of converted, formatted, or generated data.

steps.title: Building DevToolbox
steps.description: Execute compilation and package assembly within the target build environment.
